changes_from_v2: BRPM-infeasible intents are masked before sampling.
BRPM allocation is checked again at execution as a second fail-closed boundary.
Qualification requires exposure in at least 80% of development episodes and a BRPM rejection rate at or below 5%.
failure_analysis: The feasibility mask eliminated BRPM rejections but the policy collapsed to WAIT on every development step.
All six development paths had zero probes, zero exposure and zero return.
The existing missed-opportunity feedback was insufficient to overcome the zero-position local optimum after risk-invalid actions were removed.
limitations: Results use synthetic DEVELOPMENT paths from the same generator family as TRAIN.
The failed policy was not admitted to the independent unseen-seed exam.
No SEALED_TEST or real BTC history was opened.
This result does not authorize LIVE, TESTNET or automatic promotion.
